name: Date Sugar
siboNotes: Use sparingly as dates contain fructose and fructans that can feed bacterial overgrowth. Start with minimal amounts during SIBO treatment.
preparationTips: Measure carefully as small amounts add up quickly in recipes
Mix with low FODMAP spices like cinnamon to enhance sweetness perception
Use in baking rather than as table sweetener for better portion control
Combine with maple syrup or rice malt syrup for lower FODMAP sweetening
nutritionalHighlights: Contains potassium and antioxidants from dates
Contains small amounts of iron and copper
